cue.en: Soften your knees so you can push off either way.

rationale.en: Straight knees delay the first step.

positive_cue.en: Nice loaded knees.

cue.en: Adjust your base: feet about shoulder-width apart or a little wider.

rationale.en: A balanced base lets you move to any corner.

positive_cue.en: Good base width.

cue.en: Keep the racket up and in front.

rationale.en: A low racket costs preparation time on the next shot.

cue.en: Keep your shoulders level over your hips.

rationale.en: Lateral lean shifts weight off the balls of the feet.

cue.en: Match the reference position more closely: check knee bend and arm position.

rationale.en: This compares your joint angles with the recorded expert position for the same camera view.

positive_cue.en: Close to the reference position.

cue.en: Bend the front knee and get down to the ball.

rationale.en: Hitting from an upright stance loses reach and control.

positive_cue.en: Good low position.

cue.en: Get the racket up and back before the ball arrives.

rationale.en: Early preparation turns a rushed hit into a controlled downswing.

positive_cue.en: Nice early preparation.

cue.en: Sit lower: bend the knees and keep the racket compact.

rationale.en: Straight knees delay the first step.

positive_cue.en: Nice loaded knees.

cue.en: Let the front knee load to about a right angle.

rationale.en: A deep, controlled lunge drops the hips and reaches the ball with balance.

positive_cue.en: Good lunge depth.

cue.en: Keep your front knee over your foot.

rationale.en: The knee finishing above the ankle protects the joint and lets you push back.

positive_cue.en: Knee lined up well.

cue.en: Stay taller through the chest as you reach.

rationale.en: Excess forward lean slows the push back.

cue.en: Reach with the arm and legs, not by folding the torso.

rationale.en: A collapsed torso makes the push back slower and less balanced.

cue.en: Finish the swing high toward your target.

rationale.en: A high follow-through keeps length on drives and lobs.

cue.en: Stay low as you move: keep the knees bent.

rationale.en: A low centre lets you stop and change direction quickly.

positive_cue.en: Nice low movement.

cue.en: Arrive balanced: shoulders level over the hips.

rationale.en: A balanced arrival lets you hit or push off immediately.

cue.en: Move with quicker, shorter steps.

rationale.en: Shorter steps get you there sooner and balanced.

cue.en: Get back quicker after the shot.

rationale.en: From the T every corner is reachable.

positive_cue.en: Good recovery.

cue.en: Land the split step with your feet about shoulder-width apart.

rationale.en: A balanced landing lets you push off in any direction.

cue.en: Land softer with bent knees so you are loaded to move.

rationale.en: Stiff landings lose the elastic push-off.

cue.en: Let the legs lead; the racket arm comes through last.

rationale.en: Leg-first sequencing transfers power and keeps balance.

cue.en: Keep your head still through contact.

rationale.en: A still head keeps the eyes on the ball and the body balanced.

cue.en: Stay balanced over your front foot through the shot.

rationale.en: Leaning sideways through contact costs accuracy and recovery speed.

cue.en: Smooth the swing: one continuous motion from preparation to follow-through.

rationale.en: Smooth acceleration gives repeatable contact.

cue.en: After the shot, move straight back toward the T.

rationale.en: Recovering to the T keeps every corner in reach.

positive_cue.en: Good recovery to the T.

cue.en: Meet the ball at a consistent height.

rationale.en: Shown only when racket tracking evidence exists.

cue.en: Slow the swing and push the ball into the corner.

rationale.en: The drop is a controlled push, not a hit.

positive_cue.en: Soft hands on the drop.

cue.en: Keep one foot clearly inside the service box as you strike the serve.

rationale.en: Rule 5.7.2 requires one foot inside the box with no part touching a boundary line.

AMBIGUOUS_SUBJECT.en: Two people are in view. Make sure only the practising player is on court in frame.

FRAMING_INVALID.en: Step back so your whole body, including your feet, is visible in the camera.

MISSING_JOINT.en: Some joints are hidden. Keep your full body in view, racket arm included.

LOW_CONFIDENCE.en: Tracking is unsteady. Improve lighting and avoid standing in front of the glass reflections.

VIEW_INVALID.en: This check needs a different camera angle; it is paused for now.

TIME_GAP.en: Tracking paused. Resume when you are ready.

TRACK_CHANGED.en: Lost track of you for a moment. Checks restart now.

HANDEDNESS_UNKNOWN.en: Set your racket hand in the session setup to enable swing checks.

CAPABILITY_MISSING.en: Racket tracking is not active, so contact-height checks are off.

CONTACT_UNOBSERVED.en: Ball contact cannot be seen from body tracking alone.

SAFETY.en: Keep your training partner outside the swing arc and wear protective eyewear.

WITHIN_NORMAL_VARIANCE.en: That repetition was within your normal range of variation; no correction.

MOVEMENT_NOT_CONFIRMED.en: This looks like a different movement from your selected drill, so technique tips are paused. Switch drills or return to the selected movement.
